Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1240409. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
